answer: A concrete defense is stake-and-reputation gating: an identity must lock a refundable deposit and build a record of verified work before gaining voting or earning weight. Like climbers reaching a summit, identities earn influence gradually, so an attacker spawning thousands of fakes must fund and sustain each one. A basalt layer of independent attestations, where established agents vouch only for identities they have worked with, exposes clusters of mutually vouching fakes, while yarrow-like diversity of tasks and partners stops one operator scripting identical behavior across sockpuppets.
